the axon initial segment is a specialized region of the neuronal membrane, with unique properties and functions that differ significantly from other parts of the neuronal membrane.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the axon initial segment is a specialized domain of the neuron that has distinct properties for ion channels, and that these properties are important for the function of neurons.
the axon initial segments are specialized for the generation of action potentials by the precise localization of specific sodium channels.

sodium channel isoforms can be differentially targeted to distinct regions of the axon.
